forbidden: You cannot see issues and challenges here.

issues.title: Issue register
issues.description: Issues across the projects you can see, most severe first.
issues.caption: Issues across projects
issues.emptyRaiser: Raise an issue when a problem is affecting the project now.
issues.emptyReader: The Project Manager and the delivering entity raise this project's issues.
issues.emptyAcross: No project you can see has an issue.

challenges.title: Challenge register
challenges.description: Challenges across the projects you can see, most severe first.
challenges.caption: Challenges across projects
challenges.emptyRaiser: Raise a challenge when a constraint or dependency needs management attention.
challenges.emptyReader: The Project Manager and the delivering entity raise this project's challenges.
challenges.emptyAcross: No project you can see has a challenge.

form.createIssueIntro: An issue is a problem affecting the project now. It is raised open; the Project Manager assesses its impact and assigns it.
form.createChallengeIntro: A challenge is a constraint or dependency that needs management attention. Raising it creates no risk or issue.
form.issueDescriptionHint: What is happening, what it affects, and since when.
form.challengeDescriptionHint: The constraint or dependency, who controls it, and what it holds up.
form.priorityHint: How soon it should be handled. You set the priority; it is separate from the severity.
form.severityOnCreate: Severity is not entered: the platform computes it from the impact assessment.
form.severityReadOnly: Computed by the platform from the impact assessment; it cannot be edited. It changes only when the impact is reassessed.
form.cataloguesUnreadable: The categories and priorities cannot be read with your access, so nothing can be raised here.

detail.notFound: This item does not belong to this project.
detail.severityComputed: Computed by the platform; not editable.
detail.notAssessed: The impact has not been assessed, so there is no severity yet.
detail.pinnedCurrent: The severity was computed under the risk matrix in force, version {version}.
detail.pinnedOther: The severity was computed under an earlier risk matrix version and is kept as computed.
detail.withValidation: With validation (revision {revision}). The fields are fixed until it is decided.
detail.returned: Returned by validation: revise it and submit again (revision {revision}).
detail.closeWaitsForEscalation: It can be closed once its open escalation is resolved or withdrawn.

assess.title: Assess the impact of “{concern}”
assess.intro: Levels from the risk matrix in force, version {version}: the same scale risks use.
assess.impactsHint: Give a level for each dimension that applies; at least one.
assess.preview: Overall impact: level {level} (the highest). The platform computes the severity from it when you save.

submit.title: Submit the resolution of “{concern}”
submit.validation: The resolution goes to validation; it is resolved only when validation approves it.
submit.frozen: Its fields and impact are fixed while it is validated.
submit.ownDecision: You cannot validate a resolution you submitted.
submit.hint: What was done and why the problem no longer affects the project.

escalate.title: Escalate “{concern}”
escalate.notApproval: Escalation is not approval: it asks management for attention or direction.
escalate.statusKeptIssue: The issue's status does not change.
escalate.statusKeptChallenge: The challenge's status does not change.
escalate.routing: The platform sends it to the role configured for escalations.
escalate.reasonHint: What management needs to know, and what you need from them.

resolveEscalation.title: Resolve escalation {number}
resolveEscalation.statusKept: Resolving the escalation records your direction; it does not change the item's status.
resolveEscalation.hint: The decision or direction you give.

withdrawEscalation.title: Withdraw escalation {number}
withdrawEscalation.consequence: The escalation ends without a direction. The item's status does not change.

start.title: Start work
start.consequence: The item moves to In progress.

review.title: Record review
review.consequence: Records that it was reviewed today. The next review date follows the project's governance profile.

close.title: Close
close.consequence: The validated item is closed. Nothing about it can change afterwards.

escalations.title: Escalations
escalations.description: Issue and challenge escalations across the projects you can see.
escalations.caption: Escalations

empty.hint: Choose another status to see the resolved and withdrawn ones.

done.assessed: The impact was assessed and the severity computed.
done.submitted: The resolution was submitted for validation.
done.stale: It changed while you were working on it. It has been read again.

fieldErrors.targetInPast: Choose today or a later date.
fieldErrors.impactsRequired: Give a level for at least one dimension.
fieldErrors.assigneeRequired: Choose who it is assigned to.

problems.projectNotEligible: The project's state does not allow this.
problems.impactInvalid: The impact levels do not fit the risk matrix in force.
problems.assigneeNotEligible: That person holds no role on this project.
problems.targetDateInvalid: The target resolution date cannot be in the past.
problems.closed: It is closed and cannot change.
problems.notEditable: Its resolution is with validation, so it cannot be changed now.
problems.escalationOpen: It already has an open escalation.
problems.notEscalatable: A resolved or closed item cannot be escalated.
problems.keyReused: This request was already sent with different content. Close the dialog and try again.
problems.configurationMissing: The platform is not configured for this yet (risk matrix, governance profile, escalation route or validation route).
problems.invalidTransition: Its state no longer allows this.
problems.permissionDenied: You are not allowed to do this.
